pairs.subject: voice-io
pairs.evidence: app/_components/studio/StudioVoiceBar.tsx:118 The kit wires the two pipelines independently: dictation has a live meter and appends to an editable draft without sending, and read-aloud has a one-door normalizer, opt-in auto-speak and stop-on-switch. Each degrades on its own sticky unavailable latch, which matches the golden path's two-pipeline, degrade-never-block shape.

techniques.evidence: app/_components/studio/StudioVoiceBar.tsx:118 There is a continuously visible level meter while listening, painted only when the level is really measured, so a flat bar never gives a false diagnosis. The capture is toggled explicitly, and mic errors render from their code.

app/_components/studio/useStudioSpeech.ts:127 'Stop means now' extends to a session switch. Synthesis is aborted and the element released through the voice-tts package, and the surface only uses speak, stop and resume.
app/_components/studio/useStudioSpeech.ts:102 There is one door before the engine, so markdown is not voiced. An empty result means there is nothing to say.
app/_components/studio/useStudioDictation.ts:76 The surface talks to the host route and never names an engine.
app/_components/studio/useStudioSpeech.ts:4 Both hooks are thin wrappers over the portable packages/voice-tts and packages/voice-stt. Only surface policy lives in the kit.

app/_components/studio/studioVoiceIo.ts:77 Auto-speak is OFF by default, primed on mount and silent in a hidden tab. A missing capability is drawn as a struck glyph with its reason (StudioVoiceBar.tsx:103).

app/_components/studio/studioVoiceIo.ts:100 Only the join point is touched. The destination is an editable draft that a model reads, which is the technique's 'destination is a model' exclusion, so no rewrite pass belongs here.
app/_components/studio/studioVoiceIo.ts:85 The transcript never crosses into a typed command; it is free text that the user edits.
app/_components/studio/useStudioSpeech.ts:107 The speak call is fire-and-forget, so nothing waits on playback.
app/_components/studio/StudioVoiceBar.tsx:49 The destination is the product's own text field, which is the technique's first exclusion. No clipboard is involved.
app/_components/studio/StudioComposer.tsx:29 The kit is turn-based. A full-call relay arrives as a consumer slot, so no duplex session is hosted here.
